*Bringing necessary packages into current session*

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(rsample)
library(tidymodels)
library(baguette)
library(ranger)
```

# PART ONE : EDA

*Reading in data*

```{r}
seoul_bike_data <- read_csv('HW9/SeoulBikeData.csv', locale = locale(encoding = 'Latin1'))
```

*Checking for missing values*

```{r}
is.na(seoul_bike_data)
#No NAs!
```

*Checking column types and values within columns*

```{r}
#Checking column types
str(seoul_bike_data)

#Checking summary statistics
num_summaries <- seoul_bike_data |>
  select(`Temperature(°C)`, `Humidity(%)`, `Wind speed (m/s)`, `Visibility (10m)`, `Dew point temperature(°C)`, `Solar Radiation (MJ/m2)`, `Rainfall(mm)`, `Snowfall (cm)`, `Rented Bike Count`, Hour)

summary(num_summaries)

#Checking categorical variable unique values
unique(seoul_bike_data$Seasons)
unique(seoul_bike_data$Holiday)
unique(seoul_bike_data$`Functioning Day`)
```

*Changing **Date** data*

```{r}
#Date is stored in a day/month/year format as a character
seoul_bike_data_new <- seoul_bike_data |>
  mutate(Date = dmy(Date))

str(seoul_bike_data_new$Date)
```

*Changing characters into factors*

```{r}
seoul_bike_data_cat <- seoul_bike_data_new |>
  mutate(
    Seasons = as.factor(Seasons),
    Holiday = as.factor(Holiday),
    `Functioning Day` = as.factor(`Functioning Day`)
  )
str(seoul_bike_data_cat$Seasons)
str(seoul_bike_data_cat$Holiday)
str(seoul_bike_data_cat$`Functioning Day`)
```

*Renaming all variables*

```{r}
seoul_bike_data_final <- seoul_bike_data_cat |>
  rename(date = Date, rented_bike_count = `Rented Bike Count`, hour = Hour, temp = `Temperature(°C)`, humidity = `Humidity(%)`, windspeed = `Wind speed (m/s)`, visibility = `Visibility (10m)`, dew_point_temp = `Dew point temperature(°C)`, solar_rad = `Solar Radiation (MJ/m2)`, rainfall = `Rainfall(mm)`, snowfall = `Snowfall (cm)`, seasons = Seasons, holiday = Holiday, fun_day = `Functioning Day`)

str(seoul_bike_data_final)
```

*Creating summary statistics*

```{r}
#Calculating mean, sd, and median for bike rentals
seoul_bike_data_final |>
  summarize(mean_rent = mean(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count), med_rent = median(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count), sd_rent = sd(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count))

seoul_bike_data_final |>
  group_by(seasons) |>
  summarize(mean_rent = mean(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count), med_rent = median(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count), sd_rent = sd(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count))

seoul_bike_data_final |>
  group_by(holiday) |>
  summarize(mean_rent = mean(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count), med_rent = median(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count), sd_rent = sd(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count))

seoul_bike_data_final |>
  group_by(fun_day) |>
  summarize(mean_rent = mean(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count), med_rent = median(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count), sd_rent = sd(seoul_bike_data_final$rented_bike_count))

#Filtering out days that were not functioning
new_bike_data <- seoul_bike_data_final |>
  filter(fun_day != 'No')

new_bike_data$fun_day
```

*Summarizing daily data*

```{r}
#Getting all of the means and sums for the numeric variables
day_bike_data <- new_bike_data |>
  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) |>
  summarize(
    bike_sum = sum(rented_bike_count),
    rain_sum = sum(rainfall),
    snow_sum = sum(snowfall),
    mean_hum = mean(humidity),
    mean_temp = mean(temp),
    mean_wind = mean(windspeed),
    mean_dew = mean(dew_point_temp),
    mean_solar = mean(solar_rad),
    mean_vis = mean(visibility),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

str(day_bike_data)
```

*Recreating summary stats*

~Summaries~

```{r}
#Finding mean, median, and standard deviation for bike_sum, with the last two being across the seasons and holiday categories
day_bike_data |>
  summarize(mean_bike = mean(bike_sum), med_bike = median(bike_sum), sd_bike = sd(bike_sum))

day_bike_data |>
  group_by(seasons) |>
  summarize(mean_bike = mean(bike_sum), med_bike = median(bike_sum), sd_bike = sd(bike_sum))

day_bike_data |>
  group_by(holiday) |>
  summarize(mean_bike = mean(bike_sum), med_bike = median(bike_sum), sd_bike = sd(bike_sum))

```

# PART TWO: SPLITTING THE DATA

*Using the **initial_split** function to create training and testing sets of data*

```{r}
set.seed(558)

split_data <- initial_split(day_bike_data, prop = 3/4, strata = seasons)

testing_data <- testing(split_data)
training_data <- training(split_data)
```

*Creating the CV folds*

```{r}
set.seed(558)

training_folds <- vfold_cv(data = training_data, v = 10)

training_folds
```

# PART THREE: FITTING MLR MODELS

*First recipe, uses **weekend** and **weekday** variable, removes **date**, standardizes numeric predictors, and creates dummy variables*

```{r}
model_1 <- recipe(bike_sum ~ ., data = training_data) |>
  step_date(date, features = 'dow') |>
  step_mutate(day_type = factor(if_else(date_dow %in% c('Sat', 'Sun'), 'Weekend', 'Weekday'))) |>
  step_rm(date, date_dow) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

model_1
```

*Second recipe, adds interaction terms to previous recipe*

```{r}
model_2 <- recipe(bike_sum ~ ., data = training_data) |>
  step_date(date, features = 'dow') |>
  step_mutate(day_type = factor(if_else(date_dow %in% c('Sat', 'Sun'), 'Weekend', 'Weekday'))) |>
  step_rm(date, date_dow) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_interact(terms = ~ starts_with('seasons_'):starts_with('holiday_') + starts_with('seasons_'):mean_temp + mean_temp:rain_sum)

model_2
```

*Third recipe, adding squared terms for **mean_temp** and **mean_hum***

```{r}
model_3 <- recipe(bike_sum ~ ., data = training_data) |>
  step_date(date, features = 'dow') |>
  step_mutate(day_type = factor(if_else(date_dow %in% c('Sat', 'Sun'), 'Weekend', 'Weekday'))) |>
  step_rm(date, date_dow) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_interact(terms = ~ starts_with('seasons_'):starts_with('holiday_') + starts_with('seasons_'):mean_temp + mean_temp:rain_sum) |>
  step_mutate(temp_sq = mean_temp^2, hum_sq = mean_hum^2)

model_3
```

*Fitting all recipes*

```{r}
lin_reg_model <- linear_reg() |>
  set_engine('lm')

lin_reg_model
```

*Workflows for all three recipes*

```{r}
workflow_1 <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(model_1) |>
  add_model(lin_reg_model)

workflow_2 <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(model_2) |>
  add_model(lin_reg_model)

workflow_3 <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(model_3) |>
  add_model(lin_reg_model)
```

*Fitting with CV folds*

```{r}
set.seed(558)

cv_fit_1 <- fit_resamples(workflow_1, resamples = training_folds, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

cv_fit_2 <- fit_resamples(workflow_2, resamples = training_folds, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

cv_fit_3 <- fit_resamples(workflow_3, resamples = training_folds, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))
```

*Comparing models*

```{r}
results <- bind_rows(
  collect_metrics(cv_fit_1) |>
    mutate(model = 'Model 1'),
  collect_metrics(cv_fit_2) |>
    mutate(model = 'Model 2'),
  collect_metrics(cv_fit_3) |>
    mutate(model = 'Model 3')
)

results

results |>
  select(model, .metric, mean, std_err)
```

~*The model with the lowest RMSE is **Model 3***.~

*Fitting **Model 3***

```{r}
lin_model <- last_fit(
  workflow_3,
  split = split_data,
  metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae)
)

collect_metrics(lin_model)
```

*Finding coefficients*

```{r}
lin_model_coef <- extract_workflow(lin_model) |>
  extract_fit_parsnip()
tidy(lin_model_coef)
```

# PART FOUR: FITTING OTHER MODELS

*Regression tree model*

```{r}
#Making model
reg_tree_model <- decision_tree(cost_complexity = tune(), tree_depth = tune()) |>
  set_engine('rpart') |>
  set_mode('regression')

#Creating workflow
reg_tree_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(model_1) |>
  add_model(reg_tree_model)

#Creating grid
reg_grid <- grid_regular(cost_complexity(), tree_depth(), levels = 3)

#Applying grid
reg_tree_tuned <- tune_grid(reg_tree_workflow, resamples = training_folds, grid = reg_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

#Finding best fit & finalizing
best_model <- select_best(reg_tree_tuned, metric = 'rmse')
reg_workflow_final <- finalize_workflow(reg_tree_workflow, best_model)

#Performing last fit
reg_tree_final <- last_fit(reg_workflow_final, split = split_data, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

#Collecting metrics
collect_metrics(reg_tree_final)
```

*Bagged tree model*

```{r}
#Creating model
bag_model <- bag_tree(cost_complexity = tune(), tree_depth = tune()) |>
  set_engine('rpart') |>
  set_mode('regression')

#Creating workflow
bag_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(model_1) |>
  add_model(bag_model)

#Doing resamples
bag_cv <- bag_workflow |>
  tune_grid(resamples = training_folds, grid = reg_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

#Selecting best fit & finalizing
bag_select <- select_best(bag_cv, metric = 'rmse')
bag_finalize <- finalize_workflow(bag_workflow, bag_select)

#Performing last_fit
fit_bag <- last_fit(bag_finalize, split = split_data, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

#Collecting metrics
collect_metrics(fit_bag)
```

*Random forest model*

```{r}
#Creating model
forest_model <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 1000) |>
  set_engine('ranger', importance = 'impurity') |>
  set_mode('regression')

#Creating workflow
forest_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_model(forest_model) |>
  add_recipe(model_1)

#Creating grid
forest_grid <- grid_regular(mtry(range = c(1,13)), min_n(), levels = 5)

#Resamples
forest_cv <- forest_workflow |>
  tune_grid(resamples = training_folds, grid = forest_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

#Finding best fit & finalizing
forest_best <- select_best(forest_cv, metric = 'rmse')
forest_finalize <- finalize_workflow(forest_workflow, forest_best)

#Performing last_fit
fit_forest <- last_fit(forest_finalize, split = split_data, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

#Collecting metrics
collect_metrics(fit_forest)
```

*Comparing final models*

```{r}
#Creating tibble to display all collected metrics
final_models <- bind_rows(
  collect_metrics(lin_model) |>
    mutate(model = 'Lin Reg'),
  
  collect_metrics(reg_tree_final) |>
    mutate(model = 'Reg Tree'),
  
  collect_metrics(fit_bag) |>
    mutate(model = 'Bagged Tree'),
  
  collect_metrics(fit_forest) |>
    mutate(model = 'Random Forest')
)

#Subsetting by model, .metric, and .estimate
final_models |>
  select(model, .metric, .estimate)
```

~The random\ forest model has the lower RMSE, so we can confirm that this model is likely the best fit one!~
